rule: Cache-first: never re-request a cached person. Every image is AI-made and labelled.

people.name: Mayer Amschel Rothschild
people.label: AI-imagined portrait: no likeness survives
people.review: Imagined (no authenticated likeness; Hubbard 1916 drawing rejected as a source). Plain c.1800 coat, waistcoat, cravat, white hair; neutral, dignified, no stereotype.

people.name: Gutle Schnapper (Gutle Rothschild)
people.label: AI portrait after Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, 1836 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Oppenheim 1836: lace bonnet with ribbons, lace collar, gold chain, aged face kept as painted, no exaggeration. Colour restored from a B&W reproduction; clean ground.

people.name: Amschel Mayer von Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, 1840s (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Oppenheim: bald crown, white side hair, order on red ribbon as in the reference. Dignified; red curtain replaced by warm grey.

people.name: Salomon Mayer von Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after Moritz Daniel Oppenheim (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Oppenheim: grey hair, heavy-lidded eyes, black stock, velvet collar. Dignified; the small lapel ribbon dropped.

people.name: Nathan Mayer Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, 1853 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Oppenheim 1853: bald crown, grey side curls, blue eyes, high white stock, black coat. Dignified, no exaggeration; no hands; clean warm-grey ground.

people.name: Carl Mayer von Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, 1850 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Oppenheim 1850: dark curls, side whiskers, red ribbon and orders as in the reference. Dignified; clean ground.

people.name: James Mayer de Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after Flandrin, 1860 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Flandrin c.1860: fair receding hair, pale eyes, black stock; dignified, no exaggeration; clean ground.

people.name: Lionel de Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after Moritz Daniel Oppenheim, c. 1835 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Oppenheim c.1835 (young Lionel): dark curls, light side whiskers, black stock; cropped from the seated pose, hands out of frame; dignified.

people.name: Nathan Mayer 'Natty' Rothschild, 1st Baron Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after an unknown painter, c. 1900 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to the seated portrait: bald crown, white beard, dark suit, red tie; dignified; hands cropped out.

people.name: Walter Rothschild, 2nd Baron Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after an unknown photographer, before 1937 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to the photograph: domed bald head, full grey beard, wing collar; colourised softly; dignified.

people.name: Edmond James de Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after an unknown photographer, 19th century (public domain)
people.review: Close to the c.1870s photograph: curly dark hair, full beard, fur-collared coat; hair a little fuller than the photo; dignified, no exaggeration.

people.name: Betty von Rothschild
people.label: AI portrait after Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres, 1848 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Ingres 1848: black hat with white plumes, pink satin off-shoulder gown; a pearl necklace was added (Ingres shows bracelets), minor; dignified.

people.name: Rudolf I of Germany
people.label: AI portrait after his tomb effigy in Speyer Cathedral, c. 1291 (photo: Haselburg-müller, CC BY-SA 3.0)
people.review: After the Speyer tomb effigy: the effigy's famously gaunt aged face and long hair, eagle shield on the chest; crown and sceptre left out per the look rules. Photo of the effigy is CC BY-SA 3.0 (Haselburg-müller), recorded.

people.name: Albert I of Germany
people.label: AI-imagined portrait: no likeness survives
people.review: Imagined (no likeness survives): plain middle-aged man in a dark c.1300 robe; neutral, dignified, no invented insignia.

people.name: Leopold I, Holy Roman Emperor
people.label: AI portrait after Benjamin Block, 1672 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Benjamin Block 1672: full wig, moustache, lace jabot, armour; the Habsburg jaw as painted, not exaggerated.

people.name: Philip IV of Spain
people.label: AI portrait after Diego Velázquez, 1656 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Velázquez 1656: long hair, upturned moustache, golilla collar, black doublet with chain; dignified.

people.name: Mariana of Austria
people.label: AI portrait after Diego Velázquez, 1652 (public domain)
people.review: Second call. Faithful to Velázquez c.1652: wide dark-blond wig with red bows and plumes, rouged cheeks, black-and-silver bodice; dignified.

people.name: Margaret Theresa of Spain
people.label: AI portrait after an unknown painter, c. 1666-73 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to the c.1666-73 portrait: fair hair with coral bows, black dress with white slashed sleeves, brooch; dignified.

people.name: Erasmus Darwin
people.label: AI portrait after Joseph Wright of Derby, 1792 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Wright of Derby 1792: heavy features as painted, own grey hair, olive coat; quill and hand cropped out.

people.name: Josiah Wedgwood
people.label: AI portrait after Joshua Reynolds (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Reynolds: powdered side-curled wig, lace jabot, brown coat; lighter ground replaces the black.

people.name: Sarah Wedgwood
people.label: AI portrait after Joshua Reynolds, 1782 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Reynolds 1782: lace cap over powdered hair, dark dress, white fichu; dignified.

people.name: Robert Darwin
people.label: AI portrait after James Pardon (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Pardon: bald head, white side hair, dark green coat, grey waistcoat; slightly slimmer than painted, acceptable.

people.name: Susannah Darwin (née Wedgwood)
people.label: AI portrait after Peter Paillou, 1793 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to Paillou 1793 miniature: blue bow, powdered curls, white ruffled dress; looks a little older than 28. First call failed on a network reset; this is the second call.

people.name: Charles Darwin
people.label: AI portrait after Julia Margaret Cameron, 1868 (public domain)
people.review: Clearly Cameron's Darwin (c.1868): domed bald head, long white beard, heavy brows; turned towards three-quarter from profile; dignified.

people.name: Emma Darwin (née Wedgwood)
people.label: AI portrait after George Richmond, 1840 (public domain)
people.review: After Richmond 1840: ringlets, pale shawl, cream dress. Reads older than 32 and adds pink ribbons; likeness acceptable.

people.name: Hensleigh Wedgwood
people.label: AI portrait after an anonymous sketch, c. 1870 (public domain)
people.review: Faithful to the c.1870 sketch: balding, round spectacles, full beard; colour imagined in the era's dress.
